wave2.merged_note: A spot market for whole H100 nodes rather than a rate card. Orders are priced in dollars per node-hour where one node is eight GPUs, so a USD 20.00 node-hour cap is USD 2.50 per GPU-hour, and buyers bid with --max-rate against a live orderbook. A new account carries compute_max_total_node_hours 5760, which is 240 node-days, and 720 on a single SKU, with a 3600-second window that does not count against the cap. Interruptible buy orders are excluded from the cap. A buyer may resell unused time.
